## v0.4.3-1 Release Notes

### ✨ Feature

- Added a unified model capability catalog with configurable reasoning levels, multimodal support, native tools, and chat parameter controls.
- Added native delivery of supported image, audio, video, and PDF attachments to compatible model protocols.
- Added automatic conversion of large pasted text into a `.txt` attachment, with an option to restore the full text to the composer.
- Added the ability to save an edited user message without regenerating a reply, plus a setting to hide reply processing steps.

### ⚡ Optimization

- Redesigned the model picker and admin model/upstream tables with clearer capability details, better filtering, and improved viewport positioning.
- Added direct image embedding through multimodal embedding protocols for image retrieval workflows.
- Improved internal messaging with a paginated emoji picker and corrected floating controls when the messaging window is closed.

### 🐛 Fixed

- Improved attachment context handling by keeping file content with its own turn, stabilizing prompt-cache prefixes, and preserving attachment awareness when content is unavailable.
- Preserved conversation context after a generation is canceled.
- Restored interactive artifact previews on public shared conversations.
- Updated the image processing dependency to address a [known security vulnerability](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w).

---

## v0.4.3-1 中文版本

### ✨ Feature

- 新增统一模型能力目录，支持配置推理等级、多模态输入、原生工具及聊天参数控件。
- 新增原生多模态附件传递，可将受支持的图片、音频、视频和 PDF 直接发送给兼容协议的模型。
- 新增长文本粘贴自动转换为 `.txt` 附件，并可将完整文本重新放回输入框。
- 新增仅保存用户消息编辑而不重新生成回复的操作，并可在设置中隐藏回复处理步骤。

### ⚡ Optimization

- 改进模型选择器及管理端模型、上游表格，提供更清晰的能力信息、筛选体验和视口定位。
- 支持通过多模态嵌入协议直接处理图片，改善图片检索流程。
- 优化站内私信体验，表情选择器支持分页，并修正私信窗口关闭后浮层控件仍可能显示的问题。

### 🐛 Fixed

- 改进附件上下文处理：文件内容归属各自消息轮次，保持提示缓存前缀稳定，并在内容暂不可用时保留附件状态。
- 修复取消生成后对话上下文可能丢失的问题。
- 修复公开分享会话中交互式 Artifact 无法预览的问题。
- 更新图片处理依赖，修复[已知安全漏洞](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w)。

---

### Container images / 容器镜像

Both images support `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`. / 两个镜像均支持 `linux/amd64` 和 `linux/arm64`。

```text
ghcr.io/amaoworks/deeix-chat:v0.4.3-1
ghcr.io/amaoworks/deeix-chat-vocechat:v0.4.3-1
```

This release publishes the server and VoceChat images. Desktop installers are not included. / 本次发布包含应用服务和 VoceChat 镜像，不包含桌面安装包。
